newsitem.title: UK: BICC hits year low on downgrade fears.
newsitem.headline: BICC hits year low on downgrade fears.

text.p: Shares in British cables and construction group BICC Plc fell to a 12-month low on Friday amid continued speculation of further cuts in earnings forecasts due to weakness in its Balfour Beatty construction wing, traders and analysts said.
The stock was down 9-1/2p to 257 at 1224 GMT in modest volume of 358,718, after earlier dropping to 255p -- their lowest since 251-3/4, ironically set on December 13 last year.
"I think people are downgrading," said one analyst, who asked not to be named. "Weakness in Balfour Beatty is causing concern about the dividend."
Another analyst also expressed worries about the health of BICC's German cable operations, which showed no signs of improvement in the first half of the year.
Yet another analyst said today's fall was symptomatic of the general bearish mood of the market and there were no significant new factors affecting the stock.
